name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd.
about: Deepak Nitrite Limited manufactures, trades, and sells chemical intermediates in India and internationally. It operates through Advanced Intermediates and Phenolics segments. The company offers sodium nitrite, sodium nitrate, nitro toluidines, fuel additives, nitrosylsulfuric acid, xylidines, oximes, cumidines, speciality agrochemicals, optical brighteners, nitric acid, fluorinated compounds, DASDA, benzotrifluoride, cumene, phenol, acetone, isopropyl alcohol, and alpha methyl styrene. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~17% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~-5% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 20 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 36), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 20 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 29 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
